project: Grammar is the Last Thing You Need (GITLTYN)

regimes.positioning_note: Unconstrained grammatical Chain-of-Thought baseline paying full W_unembed and KV-cache cost on every fluency token.

Motivational empirical control (contra TokenSkip, CCoT, Sketch-of-Thought): proves English syntax accounts for 64.6%-67.1% of emitted tokens with <1% accuracy contribution, motivating pure R^d Continuous Latent Looping rather than stopping at discrete token compression.
Budget-forced CoT control truncating verbose CoT to the exact token/FLOP budget of telegraphic_cot, isolating accuracy collapse caused by syntactic token starvation.

Proposed pure R^d recurrence with fixed-capacity RingBufferLatentTee (M <= K, O(1) memory w.r.t. K; contra Geiping et al., 2025 & Giannou et al., 2023) and stop-gradient SidecarProbe g_phi(sg[z_{1:K}]) with grad_{theta_backbone} L_probe = 0 (contra Coconut, Hao et al., 2024).
